target: AArch64 QEMU virt, PCI, graphical terminal with VirtIO keyboard/tablet
command: QEMU_VIRT='-machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -m 1024 -device ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' python3 scripts/check-compat.py --probe-demo-whap
checks: Launched the unchanged stock /Demo/Games/Whap.ZC from the graphical terminal.
The expected graphical scene rendered and changed in response to its animation or control input.
Pointer movement changed the live spring/mass simulation framebuffer.
The terminal evaluated 40+2 as 42 and zstatus reported failed=0.
scope_note: QEMU runtime acceptance only; live UTM and Pi hardware behavior are not implied.
